semantics.registry_routed: Tier has at least one current Calendar Acquisition Registry profile. This does not by itself prove every authority or sub-system in the tier is fully automated.
semantics.active_runner_gap: Tier has an active acquisition method but no country-level profile in the current Calendar Acquisition Registry. Source-method discovery is complete; executable routing remains to be implemented or connected.
semantics.status_only: Tier is intentionally status/annual-notice driven and does not require an active meeting collector until its official trigger becomes true.
semantics.no_runner_required: Tier is explanatory or dormant/archive and intentionally has no active meeting runner.

policy_notes.united-states: Equibase web automation is blocked without authorization. 2026 NJRC state-issued approved calendar date/venue facts are separate and feed only Monmouth Thoroughbred, Meadowlands Thoroughbred turf, and Far Hills steeplechase, as partial coverage. No private racecourse site automation.
policy_notes.status_only: A status-only tier returning no current dated official trigger is a valid zero state, not a failed active collector.
